column1: # Shell test files that exercise build tooling rather than the shipped product,
# each with the paths whose change runs it. scripts/bats_select.py reads this
# table: `make test-shell`, land-gate and CI run every file NOT listed here,
# plus each listed file one of whose paths the change touches. The nightly
# A file left out of this table runs on every change, so a new test is
# product until it is listed. A tooling test lists itself here, naming the
# scripts, makefiles, workflows and data it reads; its own .bats file always
# triggers it and needs no entry.
#   a*b       * matches within one path segment, ** across segments
#   other     that exact path (a submodule path matches its pointer)
# Every listed file must exist and every path must match a tracked path, or the
# selector fails: a renamed script would otherwise silently stop triggering.
